description: Defines a backend-generic, movable, non-copyable, thread-unsafe Event class for synchronization in CUDA/HIP-like environments, including methods for recording, querying, and timing events.

classes.name: Event
classes.description: A backend-generic, movable, non-copyable, thread-unsafe event class for synchronization, following CUDA/HIP event semantics.

methods.name: device
methods.description: Returns the Device object associated with the event.

methods.name: device_type
methods.description: Returns the device type of the event.

methods.name: device_index
methods.description: Returns the device index of the event.

methods.name: was_marked_for_recording
methods.description: Checks if the event was marked for recording.

methods.name: recordOnce
methods.description: Records the event once on the given stream if not already recorded.

methods.name: record
methods.description: Records the event on the given stream, incrementing its version.

methods.name: block
methods.description: Inserts a wait command in the stream for the event's current version.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Queries if the event has been recorded.

methods.name: elapsedTime
methods.description: Returns the elapsed time between this event and another event.

methods.name: synchronize
methods.description: Synchronizes the host with the event.
